question: Should CodexBar sponsor ZenMux as a maintained built-in provider in the core provider registry?
rationale: This introduces a provider and configuration surface rather than repairing established behavior, so technical correctness cannot settle the long-term catalog and support commitment.

options.title: Sponsor ZenMux
options.body: Accept ZenMux as a disabled-by-default built-in provider and proceed with ordinary merge and CI review.

options.title: Decline Core Support
options.body: Close the PR without merging if the repository does not want to own ongoing ZenMux API compatibility.

recommendation.title: Sponsor ZenMux
recommendation.body: Accept ZenMux as a disabled-by-default built-in provider and proceed with ordinary merge and CI review.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the best available authority for expanding the maintained built-in provider catalog.
